body.message:
Please note that we will be able to provide the official quotation by tomorrow.

If you wish to proceed with the booking, we would recommend completing the required deposit payment to secure and block the unit for you. As the apartment is currently listed on multiple booking platforms, we may receive a new reservation at any time.

Therefore, until the deposit payment is received, we are unfortunately unable to guarantee or hold the unit exclusively for you.

We sincerely appreciate your understanding and would be happy to assist you in securing the unit at the earliest convenience.
